rules: Any liquid asset: stock, crypto, or leveraged/inverse ETF
Rotate each 6:30am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Leverage matched to conviction; asymmetric payoff preferred
Hard stop at entry; spot-crypto-only on weekends

positions.name: Volatility Shares 2x Bitcoin Strategy ETF
positions.catalyst: BTC +1.1% overnight to ~$63.1K and holding just under $64K resistance after absorbing Strategy's biggest-ever BTC sale without breaking down — supply overhang cleared, bulls in control. Meanwhile equities tape is choppy: Samsung post-earnings selloff hammering AI-hardware (MU -6%, SNDK -6%, SOXL -12.7% pre-market), Nasdaq futures -1%, Fed minutes Wednesday.
positions.driver: 2x long Bitcoin to ride the one clean bullish momentum story on the tape while sidestepping the Samsung/memory washout chopping up tech. Asymmetric setup: largest-ever single-holder sale just got absorbed at support, so a $64K breakout opens a fresh leg higher while the 8% stop bounds the downside. BITX at $11.91 is below yesterday's $12.13 close — no gap-chasing. Chose 2x over spot for conviction on a fresh overnight catalyst, and over SQQQ/SOXS because shorting a record-high equity tape with dip-buyers active is lower-odds than long uncorrelated crypto momentum.
positions.risks: BTC has stalled at $64K before — another rejection at resistance likely means a drift back to low-$60Ks, and 2x doubles that drawdown. Broad risk-off contagion from a deeper tech selloff could also drag crypto. Hard 8% stop at $10.96 bounds the leverage. Fed minutes Wednesday are a macro wildcard.
